say:3:1011326001:1.text: Good to see you! Did you sleep well last night?
say:3:1011326001:1.source_cn: 很好，很好！你们来了。昨天休息得怎么样？
say:3:1011326001:1.male: Good to see you! Did you sleep well last night?
say:3:1011326001:1.female: Good to see you! Did you sleep well last night?

choice_prompt:4:1011326001.text: Good to see you! Did you sleep well last night?

choice_prompt:4:1011326001.male: Good to see you! Did you sleep well last night?

say:5:1011326004:1.text: Granny Dahnie, we've come to say goodbye.
say:5:1011326004:1.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆，我们是来辞行的。

say:6:1011326005:1.text: We're heading to the base of the Thorned Faction to find Eomir. We hope he'll reconsider the exclusion edict and ensure fair treatment for the refugees.
say:6:1011326005:1.source_cn: 嗯，我们要去荆棘主营找伊米尔，请他重新考虑封锁令的事，...

say:7:1011326006:1.text: Go on, teach that old man a lesson. He won't remember the forest's way of treating guests unless we remind him.
say:7:1011326006:1.source_cn: 去吧，去吧。不给那老家伙点颜色看看，他哪还能想得起丛林...

say:8:1011326007:1.text: Avoiding me is one thing, but if he can't even face a few youngsters, that old man will lose all his dignity! *Laughter*
say:8:1011326007:1.source_cn: 他躲着不敢见我也就算了，要是连几个小辈都不敢接见，那张...

say:11:1011326008:1.text: Damian, we're getting ready to leave. Stay in the village and be careful with your inventions, or Granny will be after you with her umbrella stick!
say:11:1011326008:1.source_cn: 达米安，我们要出发了。你好好待在村子里，搞新东西的时候...

say:14:1011326009:1.text: Don't worry! I won't let her catch me while I'm working on my new explosive barrel!
say:14:1011326009:1.source_cn: 放心吧，我做新爆桶的时候，绝对不会被她抓到！

say:18:1011326011:1.text: What...? Did I do something wrong again?
say:18:1011326011:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么，我又有哪里做得不对吗？

say:20:1011326013:1.text: May the wind guide both you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> on your way.
say:20:1011326013:1.male: May the wind guide both you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> on your way.
say:20:1011326013:1.female: May the wind guide both you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> on your way.

say:22:1011326002:1.text: With moonlight and the symphony of insects, you still struggled to sleep? My dear, you need to learn to relax!
say:22:1011326002:1.source_cn: 有月光和虫鸣相伴，竟然还无法入睡？孩子，要学会放松！
say:22:1011326002:1.male: With moonlight and the symphony of insects, you still struggled to sleep? My dear, you need to learn to relax!
say:22:1011326002:1.female: With moonlight and the symphony of insects, you still struggled to sleep? My dear, you need to learn to relax!

choice:4:2:3.text: There's no corruption I can't fix now!
choice:4:2:3.source_cn: 感觉能一口气净化所有腐化！
choice:4:2:3.male: There's no corruption I can't fix now!
choice:4:2:3.female: There's no corruption I can't fix now!
